import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def simulate_interactions(n_users=2000, n_items=3000, n_events=60000,
                          alpha=1.0, seed=7):
    """Data tiruan: popularitas item mengikuti pola long-tail (Zipf)."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    w = 1.0 / np.arange(1, n_items + 1) ** alpha     # bobot per peringkat
    items = rng.choice(n_items, size=n_events, p=w / w.sum())
    users = rng.integers(0, n_users, size=n_events)
    ratings = rng.choice([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], size=n_events,
                         p=[.05, .05, .10, .30, .50])
    df = pd.DataFrame({"user": users, "item": items, "rating": ratings})
    return df.drop_duplicates(["user", "item"]).reset_index(drop=True)


def dataset_stats(df):
    """Statistik dasar: ukuran, densitas, sparsity, dan rata-rata rating."""
    m, n, k = df["user"].nunique(), df["item"].nunique(), len(df)
    return {"users": m, "items": n, "interactions": k,
            "density_pct": 100 * k / (m * n),
            "sparsity_pct": 100 * (1 - k / (m * n)),
            "mean_rating": df["rating"].mean()}


def k_core(df, k=5):
    """Buang pengguna dan item dengan < k interaksi, ulangi sampai stabil."""
    while True:
        n_user = df["user"].map(df["user"].value_counts())
        n_item = df["item"].map(df["item"].value_counts())
        keep = (n_user >= k) & (n_item >= k)
        if keep.all():
            return df
        df = df[keep]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raw = simulate_interactions()
    for name, d in (("mentah", raw), ("5-core", k_core(raw, 5))):
        s = dataset_stats(d)
        print(f"{name:7s} U={s['users']} I={s['items']} N={s['interactions']} "
              f"densitas={s['density_pct']:.3f}% "
              f"sparsity={s['sparsity_pct']:.3f}%")

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def popularity_curve(df):
    """Jumlah interaksi per item (urut menurun) dan porsi kumulatifnya."""
    counts = df["item"].value_counts().to_numpy()         # sudah menurun
    share = counts.cumsum() / counts.sum()
    return counts, share


def plot_long_tail(df, head=0.10):
    counts, share = popularity_curve(df)
    n = len(counts)
    rank = np.arange(1, n + 1)
    h = int(np.ceil(head * n))                      # banyak item "kepala"
    fig, (a, b) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(9, 3.4))
    a.loglog(rank, counts)
    a.set(xlabel="Peringkat item (log)", ylabel="Interaksi per item (log)")
    b.plot(rank / n, share)
    b.axvline(head, ls="--", c="gray")
    b.set(xlabel="Fraksi item teratas", ylabel="Porsi kumulatif interaksi")
    fig.tight_layout()
    return fig, float(share[h - 1])                 # porsi milik item kepala


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from b1_stats import simulate_interactions, k_core
    fig, head_share = plot_long_tail(k_core(simulate_interactions(), 5))
    print(f"10% item teratas = {100 * head_share:.1f}% interaksi")
    fig.savefig("long_tail_demo.png", dpi=150)

import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

# Deskripsi singkat enam buku pada toko buku mini (Gambar 1.1)
deskripsi = [
    "penyihir naga kerajaan petualangan",      # i1 (fantasi)
    "naga ksatria kerajaan sihir",             # i2 (fantasi)
    "penyihir sihir misteri hutan",            # i3 (fantasi)
    "robot galaksi eksperimen teknologi",      # i4 (sains)
    "galaksi astronot teknologi riset",        # i5 (sains)
    "laboratorium kimia eksperimen reaksi"    # i6 (sains)
]
genre = np.array([[1, 0]] * 3 + [[0, 1]] * 3, dtype=float)  # [fantasi, sains]
X_teks = TfidfVectorizer().fit_transform(deskripsi).toarray()
rating_u2 = {0: 4, 2: 5, 4: 1}                    # indeks 0-based: i1, i3, i5


def profil(rating_u, X):
    """Rata-rata fitur item, diberi bobot rating (Persamaan 2-2)."""
    idx = list(rating_u)
    w = np.array([rating_u[i] for i in idx], dtype=float)
    return (w[:, None] * X[idx]).sum(axis=0) / w.sum()


def skor(rating_u, X):
    """Kemiripan kosinus profil dengan tiap item (Persamaan 2-3)."""
    return cosine_similarity(profil(rating_u, X)[None, :], X)[0]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for nama, X in (("genre", genre), ("tf-idf", X_teks)):
        s = skor(rating_u2, X)
        print(nama, {f"i{j + 1}": round(float(s[j]), 3) for j in (1, 3, 5)})

import numpy as np

nan = np.nan
R = np.array([[5, 4, nan, 1, nan, nan],      # u1
              [4, nan, 5, nan, 1, nan],      # u2
              [nan, 5, 4, nan, nan, 2],      # u3
              [nan, nan, nan, 5, 4, nan],    # u4
              [nan, nan, nan, 4, 5, nan]])   # u5 (Gambar 1.1)


def kemiripan_pengguna(R, u):
    """Kosinus antara baris u dan baris lain, sel kosong dianggap 0."""
    Z = np.nan_to_num(R)
    sim = Z @ Z[u] / (np.linalg.norm(Z, axis=1) * np.linalg.norm(Z[u]))
    sim[u] = 0.0                                   # abaikan diri sendiri
    return sim


def prediksi_knn(R, u, i, k=2):
    """Rata-rata rating item i dari k tetangga terdekat, berbobot kemiripan."""
    sim = kemiripan_pengguna(R, u)
    penilai = np.where(~np.isnan(R[:, i]) & (sim > 0))[0]
    tetangga = penilai[np.argsort(-sim[penilai])][:k]
    if len(tetangga) == 0:
        return np.nan                              # tidak ada bukti: cold-start
    return float(sim[tetangga] @ R[tetangga, i] / sim[tetangga].sum())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(np.round(kemiripan_pengguna(R, 1), 3))
    for i in (1, 3, 5):
        print(f"r_hat(u2, i{i + 1}) =", round(prediksi_knn(R, 1, i), 2))

import numpy as np

nan = np.nan
R = np.array([[5, 4, nan, 1, nan, nan],      # u1
              [4, nan, 5, nan, 1, nan],      # u2
              [nan, 5, 4, nan, nan, 2],      # u3
              [nan, nan, nan, 5, 4, nan],    # u4
              [nan, nan, nan, 4, 5, nan]])   # u5 (Gambar 1.1)


class BiasedMF:
    """r_hat = mu + b_u + b_i + p_u . q_i, dilatih dengan SGD per rating."""

    def __init__(self, d=2, lr=0.05, reg=0.3, epochs=300, seed=0):
        self.d, self.lr, self.reg = d, lr, reg
        self.epochs, self.seed = epochs, seed

    def fit(self, R):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(self.seed)
        m, n = R.shape
        obs = np.argwhere(~np.isnan(R))              # hanya sel yang teramati
        self.mu = np.nanmean(R)
        self.bu, self.bi = np.zeros(m), np.zeros(n)
        self.P = 0.1 * rng.standard_normal((m, self.d))
        self.Q = 0.1 * rng.standard_normal((n, self.d))
        for _ in range(self.epochs):
            for u, i in rng.permutation(obs):
                e = R[u, i] - self.predict(u, i)     # galat e_ui
                self.bu[u] += self.lr * (e - self.reg * self.bu[u])
                self.bi[i] += self.lr * (e - self.reg * self.bi[i])
                pu = self.P[u].copy()
                self.P[u] += self.lr * (e * self.Q[i] - self.reg * pu)
                self.Q[i] += self.lr * (e * pu - self.reg * self.Q[i])
        return self

    def predict(self, u, i):
        return self.mu + self.bu[u] + self.bi[i] + self.P[u] @ self.Q[i]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    mf = BiasedMF().fit(R)
    obs = np.argwhere(~np.isnan(R))
    err = [R[u, i] - mf.predict(u, i) for u, i in obs]
    print("RMSE latih:", round(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(err)))), 3))
    for i in (1, 3, 5):
        print(f"r_hat(u2, i{i + 1}) =", round(float(mf.predict(1, i)), 2))

import numpy as np


def hibrida_berbobot(pred_cf, pred_cbf, n_item, kappa=10.0):
    """Bobot CF naik seiring jumlah rating item (Persamaan 2-13)."""
    a = n_item / (n_item + kappa)
    return a * pred_cf + (1 - a) * pred_cbf


def hibrida_beralih(pred_cf, pred_cbf, n_item, tau=5):
    """CF bila item cukup dinilai, selain itu CBF (Persamaan 2-12)."""
    return np.where(n_item >= tau, pred_cf, pred_cbf)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    n_item = np.array([0, 2, 10, 50])            # jumlah rating tiap item
    pred_cf = np.full(4, 4.5)                    # CF dan CBF dibuat konstan
    pred_cbf = np.full(4, 3.5)                   # agar efek bobot terlihat
    print("n_item  :", n_item)
    print("berbobot:", np.round(hibrida_berbobot(pred_cf, pred_cbf, n_item), 2))
    print("beralih :", hibrida_beralih(pred_cf, pred_cbf, n_item))

"""3.2: identifikasi aspek (kamus kata kunci) + skor sentimen per kalimat."""
import re
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.special import softmax

LEXICON = {                      # contoh kamus restoran (bahasa Indonesia)
    "food": ["makan", "masakan", "rasa", "hidangan"],
    "service": ["pelayan", "layan", "staf"],
    "price": ["harga", "mahal", "murah"],
    "ambiance": ["suasana", "interior", "musik"],
}


def split_sentences(text):
    return [s.strip() for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text) if s.strip()]


def match_aspects(sentence, lexicon=LEXICON):
    """Langkah 1: sebuah kalimat cocok dengan aspek bila memuat salah satu stem."""
    s = sentence.lower()
    return [a for a, kws in lexicon.items() if any(kw in s for kw in kws)]


def extract(reviews, star_logits):
    """reviews: {review_id: teks}. star_logits(list[str]) -> array (n, 5).
    Mengembalikan satu baris per (kalimat, aspek) dengan skor di [0, 1]."""
    rows = [(rid, a, s) for rid, text in reviews.items()
            for s in split_sentences(text) for a in match_aspects(s)]
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["review_id", "aspect", "sentence"])
    if df.empty:
        return df.assign(score=[], conf_softmax=[])
    z = np.asarray(star_logits(df["sentence"].tolist()))          # logit 5 kelas
    p = softmax(z, axis=1)
    y_hat = p @ np.arange(1, 6)               # bintang harapan, [1, 5]
    df["score"] = ((y_hat - 3) / 2 + 1) / 2   # skala bintang [1, 5] ke [0, 1]
    df["conf_softmax"] = p.max(axis=1)        # Pers. (3-2), bahan 3.4
    return df

# Klasifikator sungguhan (TIDAK dijalankan di sini): model BERT 5-bintang dari
# Hugging Face, mis. transformers.AutoModelForSequenceClassification, dengan
# keluaran `.logits` dipertahankan agar konfidens softmax tetap dapat dihitung.

"""3.3 - Empat representasi output ABSA sebagai fitur fusi (ilustratif)."""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

FLOOR, EVID_CAP = 0.05, 3  # lantai konfidens, batas bukti (jumlah kalimat)


def per_aspect_table(sent, s0, aspects):
    """Rata-rata skor dan jumlah kalimat per (ulasan, aspek).
    Hasil: s (NaN bila aspek tidak disebut) dan n (0 bila tidak disebut)."""
    g = sent.groupby(["review_id", "aspect"])["score"].agg(s="mean", n="size")
    grid = dict(index=s0.index, columns=aspects)
    s = g["s"].unstack("aspect").reindex(**grid)
    n = g["n"].unstack("aspect").reindex(**grid).fillna(0)
    return s.to_numpy(), n.to_numpy()


def confidence(s, n):
    """Pers. (3-3): margin = |2s - 1|, bukti = min(n / 3, 1), lantai 0,05."""
    margin = np.abs(2 * s - 1)
    evidence = np.minimum(n / EVID_CAP, 1.0)
    return np.maximum((margin + evidence) / 2, FLOOR)


def mean_score(s_filled, hit, s0):
    """Strategi 1: rata-rata hanya atas aspek yang disebut, lainnya s0."""
    count = hit.sum(axis=1)
    total = np.where(hit, s_filled, 0.0).sum(axis=1)
    return np.where(count > 0, total / np.maximum(count, 1), s0)


def conf_weighted_mean(s_filled, c, hit, s0):
    """Strategi 2: rata-rata berbobot konfidens, hanya aspek yang disebut."""
    w = np.where(hit, c, 0.0)
    den = w.sum(axis=1)
    weighted = (w * s_filled).sum(axis=1) / np.maximum(den, 1e-12)
    return np.where(den > 0, weighted, s0)


def build_representations(sent, s0, aspects):
    """sent: DataFrame [review_id, aspect, score] (satu baris = satu kalimat).
    s0: skor fallback seluruh ulasan (indeks = review_id).
    Keempat representasi berbagi satu antarmuka, sehingga tahap fusi dapat
    ditahan tetap saat representasinya dibandingkan."""
    s, n = per_aspect_table(sent, s0, aspects)
    hit = ~np.isnan(s)
    s_filled = np.where(hit, s, s0.to_numpy()[:, None])  # Pers. (3-1): fallback
    c = confidence(s_filled, n)                          # n = 0: hanya margin

    def frame(values, prefix):
        cols = [f"{prefix}_{a}" for a in aspects]
        return pd.DataFrame(values, index=s0.index, columns=cols)

    s0v, idx = s0.to_numpy(), s0.index
    mean = mean_score(s_filled, hit, s0v)
    cmean = conf_weighted_mean(s_filled, c, hit, s0v)
    return {
        "mean": pd.DataFrame({"s_mean": mean}, index=idx),
        "conf_mean": pd.DataFrame({"s_confmean": cmean}, index=idx),
        "concat": frame(s_filled, "s"),
        "concat_conf": pd.concat([frame(s_filled, "s"), frame(c, "c")], axis=1),
    }

"""3.5: biased MF dengan suku sentimen aspek (MF+ABSA, MF+CA-ABSA)."""
import numpy as np


def gate(c, tau=0.5, k=10.0):
    """g(c) = 1 / (1 + exp(-k (c - tau)))  [Pers. 3-4]"""
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-k * (c - tau)))


class AspectMF:
    """r_hat = mu + b_u + b_i + p_u.q_i + sum_k a_u^k * s_ui^k  [Pers. 3-6]"""

    def __init__(self, n_users, n_items, n_aspects, d=8, lr=0.02, reg=0.02,
                 use_aspect=True, seed=0):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        self.P = rng.normal(0, 0.1, (n_users, d))
        self.Q = rng.normal(0, 0.1, (n_items, d))
        self.bu, self.bi = np.zeros(n_users), np.zeros(n_items)
        self.A = np.zeros((n_users, n_aspects))
        self.mu, self.lr, self.reg = 0.0, lr, reg
        self.use_aspect, self.rng = use_aspect, rng

    def predict(self, u, i, s):
        out = self.mu + self.bu[u] + self.bi[i] + (self.P[u] * self.Q[i]).sum(1)
        return out + (self.A[u] * s).sum(1) if self.use_aspect else out

    def fit(self, u, i, r, s, epochs=40, batch=256):
        self.mu = r.mean()
        lr, lam = self.lr, self.reg
        for _ in range(epochs):
            for idx in np.array_split(self.rng.permutation(len(r)),
                                      max(1, len(r) // batch)):
                ub, ib, sb = u[idx], i[idx], s[idx]
                e = (r[idx] - self.predict(ub, ib, sb))[:, None]  # galat
                pu, qi = self.P[ub].copy(), self.Q[ib].copy()
                np.add.at(self.bu, ub, lr * (e[:, 0] - lam * self.bu[ub]))
                np.add.at(self.bi, ib, lr * (e[:, 0] - lam * self.bi[ib]))
                np.add.at(self.P, ub, lr * (e * qi - lam * pu))
                np.add.at(self.Q, ib, lr * (e * pu - lam * qi))
                if self.use_aspect:  # d r_hat / d a_u^k = s_ui^k
                    np.add.at(self.A, ub, lr * (e * sb - lam * self.A[ub]))
        return self

"""3.6: stacking dengan prediksi out-of-fold dan fusi pohon keputusan."""
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor


def oof_predictions(fit_predict, train_idx, n_splits=5, seed=0):
    """Prediksi out-of-fold: setiap baris train diprediksi oleh model yang
    TIDAK pernah melihat baris itu. fit_predict(tr, te) melatih model baru
    pada indeks `tr` dan mengembalikan prediksi untuk indeks `te`."""
    out = np.zeros(len(train_idx))
    for tr, te in KFold(n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=seed).split(train_idx):
        out[te] = fit_predict(train_idx[tr], train_idx[te])
    return out


def fit_fusion(cf_oof, sent_train, y_train, max_depth=10, seed=0):
    """Pohon keputusan di atas [prediksi CF out-of-fold | blok sentimen].
    Blok sentimen: 1 kolom (global/mean), K (concat) atau 2K (concat+conf)."""
    X = np.column_stack([cf_oof, sent_train])
    tree = DecisionTreeRegressor(max_depth=max_depth, random_state=seed).fit(X, y_train)
    return lambda cf_te, sent_te: tree.predict(np.column_stack([cf_te, sent_te]))

import numpy as np

def als_bias(R, n_users, n_items, d=50, lam=0.02, iters=10, seed=0):
    """R: daftar (u, i, r) dengan indeks bilangan bulat dari data latih."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    mu = np.mean([r for _, _, r in R])
    bu, bi = np.zeros(n_users), np.zeros(n_items)
    P = rng.normal(0, 0.1, (n_users, d))
    Q = rng.normal(0, 0.1, (n_items, d))

    by_user, by_item = {}, {}
    for u, i, r in R:
        by_user.setdefault(u, []).append((i, r))
        by_item.setdefault(i, []).append((u, r))

    for _ in range(iters):
        # Persamaan (4-3): bias pengguna
        for u, items in by_user.items():
            bu[u] = sum(r - mu - bi[i] - P[u] @ Q[i] for i, r in items) / (len(items) + lam)
        # Bias item, dengan peran pengguna dan item dipertukarkan
        for i, users in by_item.items():
            bi[i] = sum(r - mu - bu[u] - P[u] @ Q[i] for u, r in users) / (len(users) + lam)
        # Persamaan (4-4): faktor pengguna sebagai solusi ridge
        for u, items in by_user.items():
            Qu = Q[[i for i, _ in items]]
            y = np.array([r - mu - bu[u] - bi[i] for i, r in items])
            P[u] = np.linalg.solve(Qu.T @ Qu + lam * np.eye(d), Qu.T @ y)
        # Faktor item, simetris dengan faktor pengguna
        for i, users in by_item.items():
            Pi = P[[u for u, _ in users]]
            y = np.array([r - mu - bu[u] - bi[i] for u, r in users])
            Q[i] = np.linalg.solve(Pi.T @ Pi + lam * np.eye(d), Pi.T @ y)
    return mu, bu, bi, P, Q

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold

def oof_mean(train, key, k=5, m=5, seed=0):
    """Rata-rata rating per `key` (user atau item) dengan penghalusan m, out-of-fold."""
    gmean = train['rating'].mean()
    out = np.empty(len(train))
    for fit_idx, enc_idx in KFold(n_splits=k, shuffle=True, random_state=seed).split(train):
        stats = train.iloc[fit_idx].groupby(key)['rating'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
        keys = train.iloc[enc_idx][key]
        s = keys.map(stats['sum']).fillna(0).to_numpy()
        c = keys.map(stats['count']).fillna(0).to_numpy()
        out[enc_idx] = (s + m * gmean) / (c + m)
    return out

def oof_mean_test(train, test, key, m=5):
    """Untuk data uji: statistik dari seluruh data latih, tanpa skema lipatan."""
    gmean = train['rating'].mean()
    stats = train.groupby(key)['rating'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
    s = test[key].map(stats['sum']).fillna(0).to_numpy()
    c = test[key].map(stats['count']).fillna(0).to_numpy()
    return (s + m * gmean) / (c + m)

"""T2: koordinat valence-arousal item dari tag dan teks (ilustratif)."""
import re
import numpy as np

def warriner_to_unit(x):          # Pers. (5-1): skala 1..9 -> [-1, 1]
    return (np.asarray(x, float) - 5.0) / 4.0

def nrc_to_unit(x):               # Pers. (5-1): skala 0..1 -> [-1, 1]
    return 2.0 * np.asarray(x, float) - 1.0

def score_tokens(tokens, lexicon, n_cap=10):
    """lexicon: {kata: (valence, arousal)} sudah di [-1, 1].
    Mengembalikan (v, kappa): rata-rata VA kata tercakup dan keyakinannya."""
    hits = np.array([lexicon[t] for t in tokens if t in lexicon])
    if len(hits) == 0:
        return np.zeros(2), 0.0
    v = hits.mean(axis=0)
    evidence = min(len(hits) / n_cap, 1.0)                  # banyaknya bukti
    spread = hits.std(axis=0).mean() if len(hits) > 1 else 0.5
    consistency = 1.0 - min(spread, 1.0)                    # kesepakatan bukti
    return v, evidence * consistency

def from_tags(tags, lexicon):
    return score_tokens([t.lower().strip() for t in tags], lexicon)

def from_text(text, lexicon):
    tokens = re.findall(r"[a-z']+", text.lower())
    v, kappa = score_tokens(tokens, lexicon)
    coverage = sum(t in lexicon for t in tokens) / max(len(tokens), 1)
    return v, kappa * min(coverage / 0.2, 1.0)              # Pers. (5-2)

def fuse(sources):
    """sources: list[(v, kappa)]. Pers. (5-3): rata-rata berbobot keyakinan,
    keyakinan gabungan 1 - prod(1 - kappa_s)."""
    k = np.array([s[1] for s in sources])
    if k.sum() == 0:
        return np.zeros(2), 0.0                             # cadangan: netral
    v = (k[:, None] * np.array([s[0] for s in sources])).sum(0) / k.sum()
    return np.clip(v, -1, 1), float(1 - np.prod(1 - k))

"""T3/O1: dual-tower dengan personalized gating (ilustratif, PyTorch)."""
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class ItemTower(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_items, n_feat, d=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.emb = nn.Embedding(n_items, d)
        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d + n_feat + 2, d), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(d, d))
    def forward(self, item_ids, feats, va):            # va: (n, 2) = v_i
        x = torch.cat([self.emb(item_ids), feats, va], dim=-1)
        return F.normalize(self.mlp(x), dim=-1)

class GatedUserTower(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_users, n_ctx, d=64, eta=3.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.user = nn.Embedding(n_users, d)
        self.long = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, d), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(d, d))
        self.sess = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.gate = nn.Linear(d + n_ctx + d, d)       # Pers. (5-7), gerbang bervektor
        self.eta = eta
    def forward(self, user_ids, ctx, sess_item_vecs, sess_mask):
        e_u = self.user(user_ids)
        h_L = self.long(e_u)
        T = sess_item_vecs.size(1)                      # (B, T, d), item terbaru di akhir
        age = torch.arange(T - 1, -1, -1, device=e_u.device).float()
        w = torch.exp(-age / self.eta) * sess_mask      # bobot kebaruan (Tabel 5.3)
        w = w / w.sum(1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-9)
        h_S = self.sess((w.unsqueeze(-1) * sess_item_vecs).sum(1))
        g = torch.sigmoid(self.gate(torch.cat([e_u, ctx, h_S], dim=-1)))
        h_u = g * h_L + (1 - g) * h_S                   # Pers. (5-8)
        return F.normalize(h_u, dim=-1), g

def loss_fn(h_u, h_i, log_q, g, tau=0.05, beta_g=0.01):
    """h_u, h_i: (B, d) pasangan positif sejajar; log_q: (B,) log frekuensi item."""
    logits = h_u @ h_i.T / tau - log_q.unsqueeze(0)    # Pers. (5-5) + koreksi logQ
    labels = torch.arange(h_u.size(0), device=h_u.device)
    l_rec = F.cross_entropy(logits, labels)             # Pers. (5-6)
    g_bar = g.mean(0).clamp(1e-6, 1 - 1e-6)
    omega = (g_bar * g_bar.log() + (1 - g_bar) * (1 - g_bar).log()).sum()  # Pers. (5-10)
    return l_rec + beta_g * omega

"""O4: re-ranking berbasis mood sesi (Pers. 5-14 s.d. 5-17)."""
import numpy as np

DIAG = 2 * np.sqrt(2)                       # jarak maksimum di [-1, 1]^2

def alignment(V, m):
    """Pers. (5-14): a = 1 - ||v - m|| / (2 sqrt 2); V: (n, 2), m: (2,)."""
    return 1.0 - np.linalg.norm(V - m, axis=1) / DIAG

def rerank(cand_ids, r, V, m_star, K=10, lam=0.3, g_bar_u=None, lam_max=0.6, kappa=None):
    """cand_ids, r: kandidat dan skor Tahap A; V: koordinat VA kandidat."""
    r = np.asarray(r, float)
    r_t = (r - r.min()) / max(r.max() - r.min(), 1e-12)          # Pers. (5-15)
    a = alignment(np.asarray(V, float), np.asarray(m_star, float))
    if kappa is not None:                     # item meragukan -> a ditarik ke netral
        a = kappa * a + (1 - kappa) * 0.5
    if g_bar_u is not None:                   # Pers. (5-17), perluasan konseptual
        lam = lam_max * (1.0 - g_bar_u)
    s = (1 - lam) * r_t + lam * a                                  # Pers. (5-16)
    order = np.argsort(-s)[:K]
    return [cand_ids[j] for j in order], s[order], a[order]
